subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should the canonical fix be limited to a new `skills lint` command, or must normal `skills list`, `skills check`, `skills.status`, and Web skills UI expose skipped-candidate diagnostics before this issue closes?
rationale: Current main still lacks diagnostics, and the open candidate PR addresses the core problem only through a new lint surface unless maintainers explicitly accept that narrower scope.

options.title: Require normal diagnostic surfaces
options.body: Keep this issue open until skipped-candidate diagnostics reach normal list/check/status/Web flows or an explicitly tracked follow-up owns those surfaces.

options.title: Accept lint-first scope
options.body: Land a corrected lint implementation as the first step and keep or create a narrower follow-up for status and Web visibility.

options.title: Close after lint only
options.body: Treat a corrected `skills lint` command as sufficient for this issue even if normal status/list/Web output remains silent.

recommendation.title: Require normal diagnostic surfaces
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until skipped-candidate diagnostics reach normal list/check/status/Web flows or an explicitly tracked follow-up owns those surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent path history puts this person closest to the loader/status surfaces and CLI behavior under review.
